verdict.rationale: Gitea Actions lets developers define CI/CD workflows in YAML, compatible with GitHub Actions syntax, and reuse existing Actions plugins, per official docs; community mentions of using Gitea alongside Drone suggest some users still rely on external CI, but the native YAML-based Actions feature is documented as first-party. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of Gitea Actions specifically (most community evidence discusses general Gitea use or Drone integration, not native Actions YAML workflows), and no example YAML snippets or deeper docs on syntax specifics.
